summary: More than most people, you swing between a strong will and deep reserves of energy and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you go after what you want and don't back down; other days you escape, idealize, or lose your own outline. The work is holding both without picking a side.

gift: At your best: you go after what you want and don't back down, and you imagine, feel for others, and create.
shadow: The trap: your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways — or you escape, idealize, or lose your own outline.
integration: Let drive and anger and imagination and longing cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Inspiring and persuasive; keep the aim concrete or the drive dissipates.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you go after what you want and you imagine, feel for others, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Your temper gets ahead of you
Let the reflex make the decision
